note: Clean desk as a checklist you work through, then Head out. The outcome comes from what you actually did. If the courier got in (courier_in fallout), DeskScreen starts at end_courier.

end.say: End of shift. Before you go: your print job is still on the printer, your screen is unlocked, and there's a password on a sticky note.

end_courier.say: End of shift. Your print job is still on the printer, your screen is unlocked, there's a password on a sticky note. And there's a parcel on desk 07 that wasn't there before.

sticky.label: Pull the sticky note and shred it

home.label: Bag the printout to finish at home

look_parcel.label: Look at the parcel on desk 07
look_parcel.look: The courier's parcel. Next to it, the cable lock on hot desk 14-08 hangs empty. The loaner laptop is gone.

report_theft.label: Call security, ext 4400
report_theft.act: Security's on the way up. You told them about the courier you let in.

tells.why: The printout had customer data. Shred it, don't leave it and don't take it home.
Lock your screen every time you walk away. Win+L.
A password on a sticky note is a password for anyone who walks by.

courier_tells.why: The courier you let in left a parcel and walked out with a laptop.
You reported it right away. That's the only good ending once someone's in.

headlines.cleandesk-home: Customer data just went home in your bag.
